title: ASTM F2924-14(2021) Standard Specification for Additive Manufacturing Titanium-6 Aluminum-4 Vanadium with Powder Bed Fusion
notes: Public ASTM store product page read on 2026-10-15. Active standard; the page lists F2924-14(2021) as the current version, with F2924-14, F2924-12a and F2924-12 as earlier versions. Committee F42, subcommittee F42.05, Book of Standards volume 10.04. Scope as stated on the public page: Ti-6Al-4V components made by full-melt powder bed fusion (electron beam or laser), covering component classes, feedstock, microstructure, chemical composition and mechanical properties. Purchase required. Only the public product-page metadata was read; the standard text was not accessed, and none of its tables (chemical composition including the interstitial O, N and H limits, tensile minimums) is reproduced in this repository. The ASTM page states that use of AI on ASTM standards is prohibited, so this record cites designation, title and scope only. A supplier must work from a controlled copy and state the clause, class and condition it certifies against.
